label: AFFECTION

cover.headline: 5 gifts of attention *that mean more than presents*
cover.sub: Small, free, and hard to forget.

points.heading: Ten minutes of full attention
points.body: No phones, no chores. Just listening.
points.panel: “Tell me about your day. I’m all yours.”

points.heading: A note in an unexpected place
points.body: A pocket, a lunch bag, the bathroom mirror.
points.panel: “Thank you for everything you do. I see it.”

points.heading: Doing a task he dislikes
points.body: Taking something off his plate says “I’ve got you.”

points.heading: Remembering something he said
points.body: It shows you were really listening.
points.panel: “How did that meeting you were worried about go?”

points.heading: Planning a small surprise
points.body: His favorite meal, a song, a short drive.
points.panel: Recreate something from your early days together.

caption:
In a season full of shopping lists, it’s easy to forget that the gifts couples remember most are often free.

Attention, small surprises, and being truly noticed can mean more than anything wrapped. Here are five gifts you can give this week, no shopping required. Pick one and see how it lands.

Save this for gift season, and share it with someone who’d love it.
